verdict.rationale: An HRIS/payroll sync is a fair question for an equity-management platform like Carta, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions a Gusto, Rippling or other HRIS/payroll integration, or any automatic flow of new hires and terminations into stakeholder records. The documented API endpoints (listing stakeholders, creating draft option grants) are developer building blocks, not the sync capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, stakeholders sync from my HRIS/payroll system (e.g. Gusto, Rippling) so new hires and terminations flow into equity records automatically
